biomes.name: Training grounds
biomes.rule: Normal immediate movement and full visibility; no added modifier.
biomes.response: Use cover, timing and existing dash/parry without an environmental penalty.
biomes.implementation: Current movement is the control. Per-run biome selection and fixed visual contrast still need wiring.

biomes.name: Snow / ice
biomes.rule: Acceleration and braking replace instantaneous starts and stops.
biomes.response: Release movement earlier, brake before corners, choose wider approaches.
biomes.implementation: Use per-run motion configuration; cap or reset dash exit velocity before applying friction. Revalidate all turns and spawn runways.

biomes.name: Marsh / mist
biomes.rule: Reduced distant visibility, with readable landmarks and guaranteed warning cues.
biomes.response: Scout from cover, remember landmarks, avoid committing into an unseen threat.
biomes.implementation: Needs visibility rendering, fair enemy perception/cues and map-overlay policy. Do not hide a projectile that can already damage the player.

biomes.name: Crosswind heights
biomes.rule: Cued periodic lateral drift affects both friendly and hostile projectiles; ground movement stays normal.
biomes.response: Wait for a lull, compensate aim, move closer or use melee and cover.
biomes.implementation: Needs timed wind state and projectile integration, including reflections and Echo shots; no player knockback.
